# Summary {.unnumbered}

We looked at inference, training, and evaluation twice: first as systems to
build and operate, then as behavior to explain. The engineering pass gives
you something that runs. The theoretical pass tells you why it runs the way
it does, and where it will break when you push it.

The two passes are meant to reinforce each other. A measurement in Part I
becomes a quantity to derive in Part II. A bound in Part II becomes a
budget in Part I. Treating AI as an infrastructure means holding both at
once: the dashboard and the equation behind it.

## Where to go next

- Revisit a Part I chapter with its Part II counterpart open, and check
  that the numbers you measured match what the theory predicts.
- Pick one system you operate and write down its roofline, its scaling
  assumptions, and the confidence interval on its evaluation.
- Follow the references for the primary sources behind each result.
